He doesn't own a car because his old one was junk, so he isn't able to get his license back until he does. He also says he wants his social security card and birth certificate asap because jobs are asking for them. I said I'd give him a call back this afternoon to get started on getting those.

Went to the DMV and has paid off all fines and his reinstatement fee. They told him the last step was to complete a form because his car is in the junkyard, then he can get his DL back. He's going to the DMV today to get the form and will send a picture so I can help him fill it out. He also wants help getting his birth certificate and social security card back. Still using his 7 day bus pass as transportation and is looking for a job while he's out.

No housing, no job, yes resume. No transportation but was given a 7 day bus pass yesterday from Star Gospel Mission. He's waiting for them to call in the next few days about whether they have room. In the meantime, he needs somewhere to stay. He has a history of alcohol abuse and his charges are almost completely DUI related. Says he's been sober for almost 1 year. Has 1 charge of possession of crack cocaine in 2025 but reports no history of using drugs. I'll ask more questions about that once I figure out housing. He is on supervision and needs to attend DV classes. He's waiting to hear from his supervision about that. 

Forklift certified 10 years ago. Has some fines to pay, isn't sure how much. He plans to go to the DMV tomorrow to get the sheet confirming how much he owes. RDF may be an option. He has an appointment on October 28th with Voc Rehab.
